name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
overview: The command 'Thou shalt not kill,' clearly stated in Exodus 20:13 and reiterated in Deuteronomy 5:17, underscores the sanctity of human life as established by God. Genesis 9:5-6 emphasizes that human life is sacred because man is made in God's image, and therefore, shedding blood demands accountability. Leviticus 24:17 further reinforces the seriousness of taking a life by prescribing capital punishment for the one who kills, highlighting God's just and holy standard for preserving life among His people.
